hypotheses.justification: The definitions of adeleBddPrincipal, adeleBdd, globalSub and adeleSpace do not require this instance. Put S = adeleBdd D, T = globalSub K F and C = adeleSpace K F. Since adeleBdd_le_adeleSpace gives S ≤ C without this hypothesis, the modular identity gives C ⊓ (S ⊔ T) = S ⊔ (C ⊓ T). Apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective to C.subtype, then use Submodule.map_sup and Submodule.map_comap_subtype to reduce the conclusion to this identity (sup_inf_assoc_of_le, with inf_comm). Thus T ≤ C is unnecessary. This argument also covers an empty Place type and zero submodules.
